anna_cs: Heads-up 12h until Orion Health go-live. They want a single SLO packet: in-scope endpoints, exact uptime formula, evidence bundle template, and two worked credit examples for procurement. Can we finalize today?

carlos_sre: I'll draft measurement defs. In-scope: /v1/chat, /v1/embeddings, /v1/reranker. Proposed uptime SLO (calendar month): 99.92%. Credit bands: >=99.92% no credit; 99.80-99.92 -> 6%; 99.50-99.80 -> 14%; <99.50 -> 28% (cap). We'll exclude scheduled maintenance (72h notice) and client aborts.

meena_enable: I'll produce the one-pager + 8min Loom with sample SQL and two numeric examples. ETA EOD.

zack_am: Procurement wants deterministic math and invoice timing. Kate, can you add MSA line: credits applied to next invoice, processed within 30 days?

kate_legal: Yes. I'll add that text and an Exhibit A sample.

infra_bot: Maintenance window mw-2026-03-23T02:00Z flagged exempt_from_sla=true.

anna_cs: Action list: carlos finalize queries & evidence bundle; meena craft customer materials; kate draft MSA/Exhibit A; zack confirm Orion accepts calendar-month for credits. Report back in thread. :pray:
